title: California Mayor Eileen Wang Pleads Guilty as Secret Chinese Agent
excerpt: Arcadia mayor admits to running pro-Beijing propaganda site under Chinese government direction, faces up to 10 years in prison
body:
**A Spy in City Hall**

Arcadia Mayor Eileen Wang resigned and pleaded guilty on Monday to acting as an unregistered foreign agent of China, admitting she published pro-Beijing propaganda through a local news website under direct orders from Chinese government officials. The plea deal carries a maximum sentence of 10 years in federal prison.

According to the U.S. Department of Justice, Wang and her former fiancé Yaoning Sun operated a media outlet between 2020 and 2022 that systematically pushed content favorable to the People's Republic of China without disclosing their ties to Beijing. Sun was convicted on similar charges in 2025 and served a four-year sentence.

**Pattern of Foreign Infiltration**

Wang was elected to the Arcadia City Council in November 2022 and rose to mayor — all while concealing her role as a Chinese operative. Federal prosecutors say the case is part of a broader pattern of coordinated PRC efforts to infiltrate American civic institutions and shape local political narratives.

The DOJ has made countering foreign influence operations a priority, with multiple Chinese espionage cases prosecuted across California in recent years. Wang's sentencing is pending.

sources.label: U.S. Department of Justice via Livemint

nri_angle: The case underscores how foreign influence operations target diverse American communities, including Asian-American civic institutions in California — home to a large Indian-American population.
